summary.text: Robin Richards is running on the Nebraska Working People Party line in the Nov. 3, 2026 general election for U.S. Senate. She chairs the party.

paragraphs.text: Richards was born in David City, Nebraska. She earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Nebraska Omaha in 2015 and attended Colorado State University in 2018 and Cornell University in 2021.

In a Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey response, she describes herself as a Ralston graduate who works as business manager and accountant for the Nebraska Arts Council and as the state's Accessibility Coordinator through the National Endowment for the Arts.

Richards has been an at-large member of the Ralston Public Schools board since November 25, 2019, and, per her survey response, is its vice president. She was re-elected to the board in the November 5, 2024, general election.
She ran for Nebraska State Senate District 12 in 2022 and lost the general election. In 2026 she also ran as a write-in in the May 12 primary for the same district and lost.
